approval_requirements_pre_approval_field.name: approval_requirements_pre_approval_fields_ck
approval_requirements_pre_approval_field.value:
"approval_requirements"."state" <> 'pre_approved' OR (
        "approval_requirements"."pre_approval_nominated_manager_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "approval_requirements"."pre_approval_submitter_comment" IS NOT NULL
        AND length(btrim("approval_requirements"."pre_approval_submitter_comment")) > 0
      )

briefs_niche_ff_rationale_ck.name: briefs_niche_ff_rationale_ck
briefs_niche_ff_rationale_ck.value: "briefs"."niche_ff_pre_approved" = false OR ("briefs"."niche_ff_rationale" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("briefs"."niche_ff_rationale")) > 0)

briefs_strategic_priority_rationale_ck.name: briefs_strategic_priority_rationale_ck
briefs_strategic_priority_rationale_ck.value: "briefs"."strategic_priority" = false OR ("briefs"."strategic_priority_rationale" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("briefs"."strategic_priority_rationale")) > 0)

briefs_niche_assessment_brand_ck.name: briefs_niche_assessment_brand_ck
briefs_niche_assessment_brand_ck.value: "briefs"."niche_assessment_id" IS NULL OR "briefs"."niche_brand_id" IS NOT NULL

briefs_niche_route_rationale_ck.name: briefs_niche_route_rationale_ck
briefs_niche_route_rationale_ck.value: "briefs"."niche_route" IS NULL OR "briefs"."niche_route" = 'standard' OR ("briefs"."niche_route_rationale" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("briefs"."niche_route_rationale")) > 0)

niche_assessments_submitted_fields_ck.name: niche_assessments_submitted_fields_ck
niche_assessments_submitted_fields_ck.value: "niche_assessments"."status" NOT IN ('submitted','approved','rejected') OR ("niche_assessments"."score" IS NOT NULL AND "niche_assessments"."band" IS NOT NULL AND "niche_assessments"."section_scores" IS NOT NULL AND "niche_assessments"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL)

niche_assessments_approved_fields_ck.name: niche_assessments_approved_fields_ck
niche_assessments_approved_fields_ck.value: "niche_assessments"."status" <> 'approved' OR ("niche_assessments"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "niche_assessments"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "niche_assessments"."valid_until" IS NOT NULL)

niche_assessments_reviewer_not_assessor_.name: niche_assessments_reviewer_not_assessor_ck
niche_assessments_reviewer_not_assessor_.value: "niche_assessments"."reviewed_by" IS NULL OR "niche_assessments"."reviewed_by" <> "niche_assessments"."assessor_id" OR "niche_assessments"."escalated_at" IS NOT NULL
